Why Goosebumps Pop Up During Awesome Music! — Even inside a warm room, why do tiny chicken-skin bumps pop up during epic songs?
Kids science answer for "what causes goosebumps for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Tiny muscles under each hair tighten from cold air or big excitement, a leftover reflex from fluffy mammals puffing up fur for warmth.
